topics.title: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) & Bounded Contexts
topics.objective: Decompose monolithic domain models into autonomous business capabilities with explicit boundaries.
topics.example: Order Context owns checkout flow; Billing Context owns invoices; Inventory Context owns stock levels.
topics.exercise: Map out domain events and bounded contexts for an e-commerce platform using Event Storming methodology.

topics.title: API Gateway & Backend-For-Frontend (BFF) Pattern
topics.objective: Shield internal microservices behind unified edge gateways providing rate limiting, auth, and protocol translation.
topics.example: Client -> API Gateway (TLS termination, Auth, Rate limit) -> Internal Services (gRPC)
topics.exercise: Design an API gateway configuration aggregating order, shipping, and product data into a single client response.

topics.title: Distributed Transactions: Choreographed & Orchestrated Sagas
topics.objective: Maintain data consistency across distributed databases without blocking 2-phase commit protocols.
topics.exercise: Implement an orchestrated Saga coordinator with compensating transactions for failed inventory reservations.

topics.title: CQRS & Event Sourcing Architecture
topics.objective: Separate write-heavy command pipelines from optimized read-only projections updated via event streams.
topics.example: Command -> Append to EventStore -> Project to Elasticsearch Read Model
topics.exercise: Build an event-sourced bank account ledger maintaining append-only transaction events and current balance projections.

topics.title: Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry) & Service Mesh
topics.objective: Track inter-service request latencies and error propagation across microservices using W3C TraceContext.
topics.exercise: Instrument a multi-service HTTP call chain with OpenTelemetry spans and visualize the trace waterfall in Jaeger.
